description.content: Monitors stay put: Deskpin remembers each screen by its hardware + position, not its Windows index — so remote sessions reopen on the right physical monitors even after you unplug or re-plug a dock.
Pick your screens once with the first-run monitor picker; Deskpin reuses that layout every time.
Smart re-map: silently adapts when the layout changes and it's confident, and asks you to reconfigure only when it can't map reliably.
Manage machines: add, edit, duplicate, delete and ping; search by name, host or tag.
Fast to use: double-click a machine to remote, or use the ⋯ menu for Remote, Configure display, Ping, Edit and Delete.
A green dot shows which machines currently have a live remote session.
Secure by default: passwords are encrypted with Windows DPAPI and handed to mstsc through Credential Manager — the generated .rdp never contains a password.
Checks GitHub for updates on startup and offers to download a newer version.
